readme.markdown: # LinkedIn MCP Let AI tools securely access your LinkedIn network and DMs. [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-talktohumans.app-blue)](https://www.talktohumans.app) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-MCP-green)](https://www.talktohumans.app/docs/developers/mcp) [![Get Started](https://img.shields.io/badge/Get%20Started-Free-black)](https://app.talktohumans.app) [![MCP Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Remote%20Server-purple)](https://api.talktohumans.app/mcp) TalkToHumans LinkedIn MCP lets Claude, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, and other MCP-compatible AI clients search your LinkedIn contacts, network, and conversations. Use it to find warm leads, hidden opportunities, intro paths, partners, candidates, and follow-up opportunities already sitting inside your LinkedIn network. Server URL: ```txt https://api.talktohumans.app/mcp ``` ## Why LinkedIn MCP? Your warmest opportunities are often already connected to you: - old prospects - past customers - founders - recruiters - creators - investors - partners - people who can make intros But LinkedIn makes it hard to search, filter, and actually use your own network. With TalkToHumans MCP, you can ask your AI assistant questions like: ```txt Find 20 people in my LinkedIn network who match my ICP. ``` ```txt Find people who could introduce me to founder-led SaaS companies. ``` ```txt Search my LinkedIn DMs for conversations with recruiters I should follow up with. ``` ```txt Create a TalkToHumans contact view for these leads so I can message them. ``` Instead of manually digging through LinkedIn, your AI agent can search structured LinkedIn workspace data and return useful people, context, and next actions. ## What You Can Do TalkToHumans MCP helps AI clients work with your LinkedIn workspace. Common use cases: - Search LinkedIn contacts by name, company, role, tag, location, or relationship state - Find connected LinkedIn contacts who match a specific ICP - Search LinkedIn and Sales Navigator conversations - Identify warm leads already in your network - Find the best people to ask for introductions - Discover partnership, recruiting, investor, creator, or referral opportunities - Create curated contact views inside TalkToHumans - Update contact notes and tags from your AI workflow ## Example Prompts ### Find Warm Leads ```txt Use TalkToHumans MCP to analyze my LinkedIn network and find 20 hidden leads that match my ICP. My ICP is: founder-led B2B SaaS companies with 5-50 employees using LinkedIn for sales. Return a table with: - full name - LinkedIn URL - company - why they are a good fit - warmth score - suggested outreach angle ``` ### Find Intro Paths ```txt Use TalkToHumans MCP to find people in my LinkedIn network who could introduce me to my ideal customers. My ICP is: independent recruiters and small recruiting teams using LinkedIn daily. Return: - person - why they are relevant - who they may know - suggested intro ask - confidence level
